text: 中国财政部发行2年期债券，规模1200亿元，发行利率1.2517%，边际利率1.2673%，预期1.2500%，投标倍数2.88倍，边际倍数1.07倍； 中国财政部发行10年期债券，规模800亿元，发行利率1.6673%，边际利率1.6778%，预期1.6700%，投标倍数6.05倍，边际倍数1.83倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 2-year bonds, scale 120 billion yuan, issuance rate 1.2517%, marginal rate 1.2673%, expected 1.2500%, bid-to-cover ratio 2.88 times, marginal ratio 1.07 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 10-year bonds, scale 80 billion yuan, issuance rate 1.6673%, marginal rate 1.6778%, expected 1.6700%, bid-to-cover ratio 6.05 times, marginal ratio 1.83 times.
